kaikki_vikisozluk.e: فَسَّرَ الْماءَ بَعْدَ الْجُهْدِ بِالْماءِ • (fassara l-māʔa baʕda l-juhdi bi-l-māʔi)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Literally: “With some toil, he explained water as being water.”
g: Said about verbose and grandiloquent speech or writing with little meaning, or about any trivial statement.
Said about an explanation that hardly explains what it promises to.
